subject: CloudLynx & Redwood: Joint integration workshop — scheduling
messages:
From: Ankur Sharma <ankur@cloudlynx.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: partner@cloudlynx.com
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CloudLynx + Redwood: Proposed joint solution workshop

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week — CloudLynx and our marketplace team are excited to put a technical workshop on the calendar so we can unblock the integration and marketplace listing.

Proposed scope:
- 90–120 minute technical deep-dive covering auth, data flows, and deployment patterns
- Breakout tracks: runtime & ops (Redwood Dedicated/private), marketplace packaging (Cloudstore listing)
- Deliverables: integration checklist, draft marketplace artifact list, action owners

Proposed dates (PT):
- Tue Oct 13: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Thu Oct 15: 09:00–10:30 or 16:00–17:30

I attached a short outline and a starter architecture diagram for context. Would love to lock something in — please tell us which slot works or propose an alternate.

Attachments: CloudLynx_Integration_Outline.pdf

Thanks,
Ankur
Business Lead, CloudLynx Solutions
ankur@cloudlynx.com

Ankur — thanks for the outline, this looks good.

Quick notes:
- Redwood attendees: me (product partnerships), Diego (solutions engineering — integration lead), Grace (cloud + marketplace ops).
- Prefer Thu Oct 15 so Diego has time to do a brief pre-read with his team. Of your Thu slots, 09:00–10:30 PT looks best for our US engineering leads.
- Can you confirm whether you want a recorded session and whether marketplace ops (Cloudstore) should join live or just in the breakout?

If Thu 09:00 PT works, I’ll send a Google Calendar invite and attach a draft agenda + pre-read. If not, propose a concrete alternate and I’ll try to accommodate.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop

Thu Oct 15, 2026 09:00–10:30 PT

1) 09:00–09:15 — Introductions & objectives

3) 09:40–10:05 — Ops & deployment patterns (Dedicated vs Private)
4) 10:05–10:30 — Marketplace packaging and next steps (artifacts, timelines)

Also suggests we split into two parallel breakout rooms so Sonia and Diego can lead separate threads (integration hooks vs. marketplace packaging).
